title: Premium Feature Not Working and No Developer Support
body: This app advertised a weekly visual habit widget as part of the lifetime premium purchase, but the feature does not work. I contacted the developer to report the bug, and they told me to wait, but the issue was never fixed. They also ignored my follow-up email.
author: Monstera_12345

title: Simple, easy to use
body: A simple tracker for habits with options for daily, weekly, and monthly tasks. Very straightforward design and interface. Clear visualizations of results for the week and year. Allows for some customization, such as colours, reminders, categorization. A perfect tool if you want something that does a great job, without complicated bells and whistle.

author: f rdgfcggd

title: Needs Choices in Premium
body:
I'd like to upgrade to premium, but I don't need all the features. I'd need only no-ads, and more groups, and more intervals. Would appreciate separating the features so I can pay for only the ones I want. 

Other improvements needed:
- make the widget better, show calendar view  instead
- allow notifications to be set by interval (eg every two days) instead of by day of the week
- allow a "range" for intervals, eg "2-3x a week"
author: di-lyn

title: So far works perfectly
body:
This app is incredibly simple and allows me to even use it slightly differently to how it was designed and I'm really glad it works this way.

I've set the app up to help me focus on my stress (mostly for work), I've made a goal of having a day stress-free for 5 days in a week.. and another check-in goal for marking stressful days with no actual goal tied to it.

This app so far has shown its simplicity and I really think it's great, if I need to do more with it I'd consider the pro purchase.
